$comment: Every Bahamian source the wire should keep watching.
kind=rss          -> the outlet's own feed. Best text, real URLs, but feeds go down:
unverified feeds are marked "verify": true and fail soft.
kind=google-news  -> Google News RSS search. This is the path the live wire already
uses, so it is the reliable one. Each query is scoped to a civic
topic and to The Bahamas, because the general 'Bahamas' query is
what buries road closures under court reporting.
weight  = editorial trust/priority, 0..1, feeds the ranking score.
civic   = true when the source or query exists to surface service information
(closures, outages, interruptions, official notices). Civic items are
boosted in rank and never dropped by the noise filter.

civicQueries.label: Road closures & diversions
civicQueries.query: "road closure" OR "road closures" OR "traffic diversion" OR "street closure" Bahamas

civicQueries.label: Road works
civicQueries.query: road works OR "road repairs" OR resurfacing Nassau OR Bahamas

civicQueries.label: Water interruptions
civicQueries.query: "water interruption" OR "water supply" OR "boil water" OR WSC Nassau Bahamas

civicQueries.label: Power outages
civicQueries.query: "power outage" OR "load shedding" OR BPL Bahamas

civicQueries.label: Weather warnings
civicQueries.query: "small craft warning" OR "weather warning" OR "flood warning" Bahamas

civicQueries.label: Official notices
civicQueries.query: "Ministry of Works" OR "public notice" OR "notice to the public" Bahamas

civicQueries.label: Police advisories
civicQueries.query: "police advisory" OR "traffic advisory" OR "Royal Bahamas Police Force" traffic

civicQueries.label: Marco's Alert & missing persons
civicQueries.query: "Marco's Alert" OR "MARCO Alert" OR "reported missing" OR "missing child" OR "missing teen" Bahamas

civicQueries.label: Family islands
civicQueries.query: "Grand Bahama" OR Exuma OR Eleuthera OR Abaco OR Andros OR Bimini closure OR disruption
